text: The architecture is written and read back. The drift result is vacuously clean because no schematic is configured; it is not hardware verification. All budgets remain unchanged, and active-part acceptance remains conditional on closing the worst-case current and device-evidence gaps. I am recording that verification scope and submitting the documentation stage to its original completion gate.

args.old_string: Evidence achieved in this stage: validated documentation proposal; related OpenSpec specs read; installed candidate switch symbol found and actual symbol pins returned; two candidate footprints resolved. These observations do not demonstrate manufacturer pin correspondence, current-budget compliance, fault safety, final cost, or connector fit.
args.new_string:
Evidence achieved in this stage: validated documentation proposal; related OpenSpec specs read; installed candidate switch symbol found and actual symbol pins returned; two candidate footprints resolved. These observations do not demonstrate manufacturer pin correspondence, current-budget compliance, fault safety, final cost, or connector fit.

Actual Stage 2 verification: the complete architecture was read back. check_drift returned "no schematic configured; drift vacuously clean". This is a documentation-only result, not a schematic/BOM correspondence check on an implemented circuit. No schematic or board was edited, so ERC, DRC, symbol verification of captured hardware, and schematic legibility were not run; their applicable downstream gates remain mandatory. Rationale: record the observed verification scope without implying hardware checks or physical tests passed.

args.old_string:
# Tasks

- [ ] Read any existing subsystem document and the related OpenSpec capability specs; preserve applicable established content.
- [ ] Check the candidate active-device symbol, actual library pins, and candidate footprints; label exactly what these checks do and do not prove.
- [ ] Write docs/SUBSYSTEMS.md with the complete prose topology and subsystem reasoning/key values, including distinct CC1/CC2 Rd, both outputs and LED after common active protection, load-only outputs, and MCU/firmware non-applicability.
- [ ] Reconcile the complete non-overlapping unloaded-current framework and mark the 1.791 mA sum as an allocation only; require a justified worst-case total strictly below 2 mA before candidate acceptance. Explicitly reject any candidate that cannot meet it rather than assuming the 1 mA programming bin is satisfied.
- [ ] Document current-limit lower-bound acceptance above 500 mA plus protected-rail demand and upper-bound fault/thermal design obligations; preserve voltage, assembly, board size, stackup, and cost targets.
- [ ] Record decisions and newly stated constraints; synchronize any affected docs and explain intentional absent components.
- [ ] Run check_drift and reconcile its actual report. Apply ERC/DRC/legibility only where source edits make them applicable; do not claim checks or bench tests that did not run.
- [ ] Read back the architecture and finish through the original stage gate, resolving any reported obligations.

args.summary: Completed Stage 2 architecture documentation in docs/SUBSYSTEMS.md: prose power flow, USB-C attachment, common active protection, parallel outputs, LED/current accounting, MCU/firmware non-applicability, mechanical/cost constraints, and downstream acceptance gates. Synchronized the verified local MIC2544 symbol/pin evidence into SPEC.md and the protected-output capability spec; recorded decisions and constraints and resolved their affected-document obligations. Local tools confirmed the candidate symbol/pins and two footprint identities only. Architecture readback completed; the observed drift result was "no schematic configured; drift vacuously clean". No KiCad source was edited, and no ERC, DRC, or schematic-legibility pass is claimed. The 1.791 mA figure remains an allocation, not verified compliance; current definitions, exact-device guarantees, support parts, complete BOM cost, mechanical suitability, and all physical tests remain explicit downstream acceptance work. All eight original pipeline stages remain intact; this completion is for architecture documentation only.
